narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>In both systems, ukasar ukasar ukasar is six, the same as the Gumulgal name.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>In place value, the position of each word gives it a value.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Three ukasars mean four, two and one, which make seven, not six.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check a base two numeral, add the place values under each ukasar.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Ukasar ukasar urapon gives four and two, which is six.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Try eight yourself, and see that it needs four words.
